sv_intro: The brand voice brief is sent with every caption generated for this account. Derive it from your own posts or write it by hand.
sv_brief_placeholder: E.g. Warm and friendly. First line is a question. 2–3 emoji, 3–5 hashtags at the end. No price promises.
sv_brief_hint: The model sees this text as is. Markdown is fine.
sv_ai_optout: Turn off AI for this account
sv_ai_optout_hint: When on, no data from this account (captions, comments, images, brief) is sent to the AI provider.
sv_ai_disabled_note: AI is off for this account. You can still edit the brief by hand.
sv_proposal_hint: This is only a proposal. Review it, edit if you like, then save.
sv_preview_local: Local model: data stays on this computer, no cost.
sv_preview_never: API keys, account ids and client names are never sent.
sv_notes: Notes (topic, product, offer, what the image shows)
sv_notes_placeholder: E.g. New autumn menu, pumpkin latte, 10% off until Friday
sv_use_images: Send the images to the model
sv_no_vision: Your model can't see images; describe the image in the notes. Alt text and file names are sent.
sv_vision_unknown: Image support for this model is unknown; if it rejects them the request is retried as text only.
sv_voice_missing: No brand voice for this account yet. Add one in Studio → Voice.
sv_vision_dropped: The model rejected the images; only text was sent.
sv_ht_tested_hint: From your own posts: lift = reach ÷ the account median for the same post type (shrunk toward 1 for few posts).
sv_ht_overused_hint: In more than 60% of posts, without above-average reach.
sv_ht_stale_hint: Unused for 90 days but 20%+ above average.
sv_ht_none: No hashtag has been used on at least 2 posts yet.
